== swccgdb.com source removed (26 October 2026) ==
I removed the Sources line for SWCCGDB (<code>swccgdb.com/decklist/view/8/hidden-base-1999-world-champion-1.0</code>). swccgdb.com returns HTTP 500 live, and every Wayback capture of that URL is also a 500, so it can't be given a Preserved copy. The deck stays sourced to Decipher's own deck-designs page and the Dr. Torch page, both with Preserved copies. The card list matches Decipher's published list card for card.
